info.title: d365-taskrecorder
info.description: Parses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Task Recorder recordings (.axtr) and client repro recordings into a readable test-case document, optionally enriched with KB/Security context and a contract XML.

post.description: Convert a D365FO Task Recorder recording into documentation. Use this tool when the user provides a Task Recording (.axtr or reproReport XML) and wants it turned into a step-by-step Markdown test case (taskrecorder_to_markdown) or an enriched MHTML web-archive document correlating each client step to the matching server action, with optional KB/Security enrichment and a contract XML (taskrecorder_to_document). Do NOT use for ad-hoc metadata or security questions.

scopes.api://trelleborg.onmicrosoft.com/sp-tis-: Access D365FO MCP as the signed-in user
